Spring: Our season kicks off with cucumbers, kale, peppers, strawberries, and tomatoes. Our farmers, crop growers and harvesters work around the clock during the Spring months to offer our guests beautiful, top-quality, great-tasting, safe, nutritious Spring fruits and vegetables. We\'re all about healthy living and aim to promote value across our farm market. Find all the produce inspiration you need for Spring in one place: Muzzarelli Farms in Vineland, New Jersey.

Summer brings our famous tomatoes. With dozens of varieties to choose from throughout the year, there is truly a tomato for everyone. Our market also boasts a wide selection of peppers, beans, eggplants, zucchini, fresh herbs, fresh flowers, and much more.

Our farm market stays open all the way until November, with a stunning array of apples, winter squash, and cruciferous greens such as broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage, Swiss chard and collard greens. Our greens are picked fresh daily to ensure maximum flavor. We also offer varieties of pumpkins and gourds which can be used for decoration or eating.

Muzzarelli Farms makes your Fall visits unique, with our Fall fruit, vegetables and other produce, and incredible homemade food galore! We offer pumpkin donuts and apple cider donuts that are incredibly delicious. Our entire team works hard to ensure the food tastes fantastic and is handled safely for all our guests. We\'re grateful to be a part of your healthy living journey.

A more regular season with a good number of vendors, including some new faces. We also have more activities returning to the market: live music, DJs, festivals, kids art, sensory activities for children, and more. See our website for a calendar of events!

season: Back for the 32nd season, the Summit Farmers Market is considered one of the best and biggest in the State of NJ. A wide variety of vendors including 7 farms including 2 organic, one that produces wool products and 4 full farms with fresh fruits and vegetables.
We grow over 60 different vegetables throughout the course of a season.
Early Spring – we start things off with lots of GREENS-

Arugula, bok choy, tat soi, spinach, baby kale mix, lettuce mix, Asian greens mix, watercress, radishes, Hakurei turnips, ramps, scallions, komatsuna, and baby lettuce heads. PLANT SALES ARE BACK!!!!!
Mid to late Spring - most of the early crops are still being harvested-
Add in kale, collard and Swiss chard bunches, lettuce heads, escarole, broccolini, broccoli, cauliflower, beets, carrots, garlic scapes, kohlrabi, sugar snap peas, scallions, strawberries, herbs.
Summer – As the heat kicks in, many of the greens fade out, replaced by the summer favorites-
green beans, cabbages, cucumbers, summer squash, onions, garlic, tomatoes, eggplant, peppers, hot peppers, fennel, celery, potatoes, melons
Fall – the root vegetables keep growing strong, but we shift away from tomatoes and cucumbers with fall greens coming back –
spinach, arugula, dandelion greens, baby mixes, kale, collards, chard, escarole, bok choy, mustard greens, lettuces, tat soi, ginger, turmeric
We supplement the market with some certified organic vegetables and grains by partnering with other local farms:
Mushrooms from Two River Gourmet Mushrooms.

Whole grains, whole grain flours and legumes from Cold Brook Farm and River Valley Community Grains.
Black & Tan and Long Grain Brown Rice from Blue Moon Acres.
Sweet potatoes, potatoes and winter squash from Two Barn Farm.

Spend your Friday mornings soaking up small-town charm at the Allenhurst Farmers Market, a beloved seasonal tradition just minutes from the Jersey Shore. Held weekly in the heart of Allenhurst, this lively open-air market is the perfect stop for visitors looking to shop local, eat well, and experience the community vibe of a classic coastal town.

Stroll through a curated selection of local farmers, food artisans, and makers offering fresh produce, baked goods, specialty foods, handmade items, and unique gifts you won’t find anywhere else. Grab lunch, enjoy a casual walk, and meet the friendly faces behind New Jersey’s small businesses.

Whether you’re a summer visitor, a weekend explorer, or a local looking to kick off your Friday, the Allenhurst Farmers Market offers a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere that celebrates local flavor, creativity, and community—rain or shine.
A perfect stop to add to your shore getaway—come hungry, leave happy.
